prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A middle-aged man stands against a clean, light blue gradient background, positioned slightly off-center. He wears a pale blue, button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to his elbows. His expression is one of discomfort and pain, with his eyes closed and brow furrowed, as he clutches his chest with one hand and presses his other hand to his stomach, clearly indicating distress from acid reflux. In the foreground, to the right, sits a brown medicine bottle labeled "BUZZ" next to a clear glass of water, both resting on a simple, flat surface. The overall composition is crisp and clinical, with high-key, even lighting that eliminates harsh shadows, creating a sense of cleanliness and trustworthiness. The color palette is dominated by cool blues and whites, with bold orange and white text overlaying the image, drawing attention to the product and its benefits. The style is reminiscent of modern pharmaceutical advertising: direct, approachable, and reassuring, with a focus on clarity and the promise of fast relief.
